note: What a server sends to end the match and say which side won.

bits.name: side100Won
bits.note: Set where side 100 won and clear where side 200 won. A client compares the winning side with its own to show victory or defeat. The one payload captured has it set, at the end of a match in which side 200's nexus was destroyed and side 100's was not, sent to a client that had joined side 100.
